notes.title: Hotfix v2025.005.001 is now live
notes.notes:
A new hotfix version of 001 Game Creator is now live, fixing a few issues that popped up in the latest version. Most importantly, we fixed the "Critical Error #-1" error various users experienced.

2025.005.001
-Fixed incorrect arctangent calculation resolving holding point and sprite script rotation issues and further fixing geometry use value “Direction from Point (ArcTan2)” and math use value “Arctangent” from returning incorrect values.
-Fixed regression crash when using color interpolation.
-Fixed very tall tiles from disappearing when they are near the bottom of the screen.
-Made it not warn about missing “Return Value” when editing a sub script.
-Fixed not being able to provide large values for sprite pose rate.

In case you missed our previous announcement on the massive update that just dropped, check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/347400/view/511831746088535591

2025.005.000
-Fixed shop interface errors when displaying items that don’t have matching scripting ID and display name.
-P2P Demo: Fixed IP address being used when hosting and added option to use a specific IP address.
-Increased Android API version to 34.
-Fixed crash when resizing sprite sequence/tile-set collision editors too small.
-Fixed scripting error when cancelling inside equipment interfaces.
-Fixed dedicated server builds from incorrectly using OpenGL after the game has loaded.
-Fixed not being able to reference an object with a name that starts or ends with spaces when advanced option “Allow case-insensitive and whitespace-untrimmed object references.” is checked.
-Renamed “Advanced Game Settings” to “Legacy Compatibility Settings” and made some clarifications inside the window.
-Fixed Tab key not activating when a field with text input is selected.
-Fixed “Close Connection” event on the client causing future “Connect to Game Server” events to no longer report connection errors.
-Fixed crash when editing variables that have a collection stored in them via executing custom event in editor.
-Fixed not rendering 3D models on certain older Android devices correctly due to graphics chip not reporting shader issues related to number of bones.
-Fixed items’ “Maximum Value” for “Statistic Impact on Target” from not properly changing the actor’s maximum stat.
-Fixed not being able to use “Run Custom Event” in editor on a newly created custom event.
-Added “Reverse X/Y/Z Tile Rendering” map properties options allowing layered alpha-blended tiles.
-Made it error more clearly when a parameter is missing for regular events.
-Enhanced RPG: Fixed message boxes from rendering behind menus.
-3D Templates: Fixed rendering issues with some lower objects.
-Fixed crashes in various editors in a project with any unnamed resources.
-Fixed crash when receiving an invalid network message.
-Fixed losing changes to parameter arguments in script editor when modifying variables/switches/collections/tables.
-Fixed actors with “Process Physics” unchecked from receiving damage.
-Enhanced RPG: Fixed title screen from not properly disabling when starting game.
-Fixed crash from overflowing player’s number of steps when velocity is set to a high value.
-Fixed crashes from actors with too high of a velocity.
-Fixed map editor grid issues and crashes after building game.
-Made it display images with invalid dimensions when preparing resources for devices.
-Made it display image slot when preparing resources for devices.
-Made it prepare resources for devices when building game.
-Fixed taskbar icon disappearing after returning to main editor window.
-Fixed “Wheel Up” and “Wheel Down” mouse inputs from being backwards.
-Fixed “Currently In Party” for party members from being ignored when its template has “Allow changes in placed actors” unchecked.
-Fixed projectiles from not properly stopping when impacting non-solid actors when set to stop.
-Fixed tiles with shadows from occasionally disappearing when they are near the top of the screen.
-Fixed not being able to disable map volume size warning.
-Fixed comparison branches with booleans/ranges from hiding the use value when not within proper values.
-Fixed clearing of range/color parameter use values from not correctly applying defaults.
-Fixed geometry use value “Direction from Point (ArcTan2)” and math use value “Arctangent” from returning incorrect values.
-Fixed setting actor’s direction via scripting from not trigger collision events correctly.
-Improved JDK locating for Android builds.
-Fixed Android keyboard on text input fields from not accepting all keys from modern keyboards.
-Fixed Android keyboard done key from not firing input script.
-Fixed Android keyboard backspace key from not always working.
-Made Android/iOS keyboard come up if an input field is clicked on in addition to just when it is selected.

notes.title: Huge Update: Alpha-Layered Tile Support, Scripting Fixes!
notes.notes:
Spring is now in full swing, and we’re back with another round of awesome updates! With fresh 001 Game Creator and Open Dev Kit updates just out the oven, and more ways than ever to get involved in the community, there’s never been a better time to dive into development.

This update introduces a very exciting visual upgrade which is alpha-layered tile blending! Alongside that, there are major scripting fixes for geometry logic and value reliability, improvements to mobile input handling, and better Android/iOS exporting tools. Jump into everything that's been happening lately for more details!

New Version Out Now!

A new version of 001 Game Creator is now live!

This one includes several resolved bugs plus a couple critical scripting fixes that many of you will appreciate. Most notably, we’ve fixed an issue where setting an actor’s direction via scripting wasn’t properly triggering collision events. This should help improve interaction reliability in many projects. Additionally, we addressed an issue where scripting values could sometimes apply incorrectly, leading to unexpected behavior in events.

We also resolved a bug with geometry and math use values:
“Direction from Point (ArcTan2)” and “Arctangent” were returning incorrect values, which could cause major problems in scripted logic relying on directional calculations. That’s now been corrected!

A pretty sweet fix also includes an issue where the virtual keyboard in mobile devices would misbehave when input-accepting fields where involved. From not showing up normally when an input field was tapped to not properly registering character inputs. You can now enjoy a fully functional virtual keyboard and freely extend the possibilities of your games!

From older betas about a month ago, we also talked about a number of fixes and improvements like more stable projectile behavior, better tile shadow rendering, and a key script editor bug fix that prevents lost parameter changes. Mobile developers also got some attention with improved image dimension error reporting when exporting for Android and iOS.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/a13bf666f1a65e807fa245f081dc518c258d0d57.png

Going another month further back, we also introduced new map options that enhance alpha blending for tiles, allowing for smoother visual transitions. Android users on older or lower-end devices should now see much better 3D model rendering, thanks to a fix that significantly improved compatibility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/9f0c0581a98f1e0f2e33f300b8d9f25a6882421b.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/c1a2e4214c02d27532943cfc17799b5aa32a36ca.png

This only scratches the surface of what has changed since the last public version! View the full change log here: https://001gamecreator.com/changes/


Open Dev Kit's Latest Update

The spotlight this time is on VR, with full VR controller support finally landing in Open Dev Kit! You’ll now be able to bind hand position, rotation, thumbsticks, sliders, and buttons for each hand using the updated keybinds editor. On top of that, we’ve introduced a brand-new 3D VR demo so you can dive in and start building immersive experiences right away.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DcSzu7xwuk8
[previewyoutube=DcSzu7xwuk8;full][/previewyoutube]

Beyond VR, there are plenty of other exciting improvements too. A new "Move" function lets you animate game objects with smooth transitions in both position and rotation over time, especially useful for physics-based interactions. The updated hologram system also gives you better control over shadows, so things like sprite tracks and labels can now stay visible without casting unwanted lighting effects.

We’ve also expanded how keybind events work by adding input and device parameters, making it possible for the same keybind to behave differently based on the input method. And for those of you experimenting with AI features, we’ve updated OpenAI model support to include the latest o1 and GPT-4.5-preview models.

And that’s just scratching the surface. This update comes with a huge changelog full of fixes, stability improvements, and workflow polish across the board. Try it out now in the latest beta of Open Dev Kit and let us know what you think!

Be sure to check out all that good stuff waiting for you here: https://opendevkit.com/


Community Showcases

We've been teasing this for a while now and we've finally pulled the curtain. As part of our ongoing effort to spotlight the amazing work being shared in our community, we’ve officially started doing periodic community showcases! Whether it’s in-progress projects, eye-catching screenshots, or inventive experiments, we’ll be highlighting a few standout creations. It’s been awesome seeing more of you share your work lately and we'd like to keep that going!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/3ec9d378f21cc5530b49c2e35b75dea72b35cca7.png

We’re very much looking forward to seeing your creations, so join our awesome community of over 1000 members here: https://discord.gg/4sTJVV5
(Maybe you'll be in our next showcase!)

A fresh update for 001 Game Creator is just around the corner, bringing key fixes and improvements, while Open Dev Kit has some new and very exciting things in the works. Plus, with Valentine’s Day approaching us, we’ve got some lovely deals you won’t want to miss.

Upcoming 001 Game Creator Update
A new version of 001 Game Creator is just on the horizon, bringing with it a bunch of fixes for improving overall stability, and addressing long-standing issues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/c1a2e4214c02d27532943cfc17799b5aa32a36ca.png

Some key highlights include new map options that improves alpha blending support for tiles. Android users will also see a major fix where certain older/lower-end devices could not render 3D models properly at all, meaning way better 3D model rendering compatibility on all devices now! Additionally, we've fixed an item function "Maximum Value" for "Statistic Impact on Target", and newly created Custom Events now execute properly without requiring the project to be closed and reopened.

This update was actually released as a beta on our Patreon a couple weeks earlier. If you'd like to be part of the early birds that get first-access to future software betas, consider joining our Patreon community. Apart from software Betas you also get other benefits like devlogs and polls that let you shape the future of our products: https://www.patreon.com/softweir

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/9f27355cff0730d51e02b611d044aad17542566b.png

New Open Dev Kit goodies
We've been hard at work cooking some interesting things recently that we'd like to share with all of you in this announcement. Since the last update, Open Dev Kit has seen HUGE progress! The amount of fixes implemented has definitely helped its stability come a long way, and it has received numerous improvements to so many aspects, from Box2D physics, object pointers, VR, HDR, to the sprite sequencer itself, which by the way will only keep getting better.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/c54e36091607a9184d33ba4e5d2efafd3c6f448b.gif[/td]
        [td][/td]

A couple utility improvements you will also find useful are enhanced navigation controls to scene, sprite and keybind editors via WASD, with a complementary user option to change camera speed and step when using keyboard. Also check out the added navigation tools (same system as toolbar tools) to project options that allow custom navigation tabs. Finding things should now be a breeze, as we've added searching to all panels: API, resources, instances, sprite tiles, sprite poses, sprite assets, scene tiles and local variables!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/0b2f98a332bfe4d0829650ff8e8c78338a374f33.gif

Moreover, you can now access "Resource" properties for scenes, keybinds, windows, shaders and sprites, and double-clicking script nodes gives you access to user properties/functions. We've also made it display the name of a tile in tool-tip when hovering over them, and added painting of rotated and tinted tiles (color, specular, and layer color).

You will surely enjoy a bunch of these sweet additions too, like a "Default Axis" Box2D physics option to choose between XY and XZ projection of 3D co-ordinates, the "Additive" coloring mode sprite/hologram option, and infinite sprite pose sequence duration (via -1) allowing infinite length tracks (useful for ongoing effects), and a "Draw 3D Ellipsoid" render context function.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/3773a9d6b989c604c95c6f76f13539b995d9d95a.gif

There are also a few neat audio-related things like audio listener position/orientation global variables that can change the location of how 3D positional sounds will be heard (volume and panning), new parameters to the "Play Sound" function (position, relativity, range, attenuation) and a game audio listener object to automatically update audio listener position/orientation. And for our VR devs out there, we've added "Get VR Position/Orientation" functions to GameCanvas and Camera to allow access to VR locations of head, left/right eyes and left/right hands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/50e034c32b4fd51220e73a655481cf0ebae27b9b.png

Issues with the crouching and spawning mechanics in the 3D FPS Survival Horror have also been resolved, and we also improved the guidance and the mechanics of the puzzle.  For the 3D adventure, we fixed the issue that prevented progression.

Moved Example and Demo Folders 
We've recently received reports that the example and demo projects weren't working, and upon investigating further, we realized that the issues were tied to having multiple user accounts. To resolve this, we moved the location of the example and demo projects from "My Documents" to "Program Files". It is safe to delete both the "Demos" and "Examples" folders, as they will no longer be used by the engine. To access the latest demos and examples, you can create a new game and select it from the template selection window.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/650761a604014e8fc0cb5da6f26f26762a58a539.png

Loading & Restarting Issues Resolved
Various issues have been reported with how saving and loading works, and we've tackled 'em all! Some of these issues include controls being properly stored within save game data, or restarting the game causing controls to reset. We have also included some other changes such as having global variables and system scripts properly update when loading a full saved game.

Improved Performance & Debugger Fixes
Compared to previous versions, you can expect various performance improvements in both the editor as well as in your existing games! Inside the "Game Settings" you can find a new section dedicated to various existing and new performance options. You can now limit how often your actors and fields update globally with the new "Process state triggers every frame." option, which will dramatically improve performance in most projects. We've also fixed the "Slowest Trigger Scripts" feature of the performance debugger, as well added a new "Slowest Interface" option to help figure out exactly what's making your game run slow!

New Use Values & Team Fixes
We have added some new use values in preparation of a new upcoming feature that you can leverage in your projects! You can now easily access the interface co-ordinates for each of the edges of the screen, allowing you to scale and position interface elements manually in your scripts. We also added a use value to determine the alliance/relationship between multiple teams, expanding your possibilities for customizable actor AI! We have also fixed some edge-cases with how teams behaved, such as issues when a team is negative towards itself.

Fixed Render Issues, Crashes, Glitches & More
This release comes bundled with a tremendous amount of fixes, some minor such as animation stutters, some major such as game-breaking crashes. A highlight of some of these fixes include: Animations stuttering when an actor follows another actor; Crashes and memory issues related to unloading maps; Crashes when using colored text; Games not closing properly and relaunching under certain circumstances; Ensured many actor properties are carried over when using "Change Actor Template"; and SO much more! We're thrilled to release the second new update this year for 001 Game Creator, with new changes and performance improvements! We hope that you enjoy this major update and checkout the things that are mentioned below.  

Render Priority Option for Actors

If you have a project that focuses on one-on-one combat between actors or actors that constantly overlap with each other, then you'll love this new feature. We have added the "Render Priority" option to actors.  The "Render Priority" will support rendering of semi-transparent actors against each other properly when they partially overlap, or when handing z-fighting issues.

Hot Fix for the Tile-Set Editor on Tiles and Terraformations

This version also fixes the memory leaks and loss of graphics in the tile-set editor when copying, pasting and editing tiles and terraformations. Therefore, you should be able to preview everything without experiencing any graphical issues throughout the editing process. 

Inaccurate Android Touches & Text to Number Conversions (on Android, iOS & HTML5)

Additionally, mobile users will notice that this version fixes the inaccurate Android touches from certain manufacturers (OnePlus, LG and Redmi). We've been working hard to include this fix, so these mobile users won't deal with this issue anymore. Engine users should also notice that we fixed the conversions of text to any numbers that were stored in variables because it greatly impacted the stored numbers in variables on Andriod, iOS and HTML5. 

Smoother Animations in the 3D Action-RPG Template

Apart from making Android fixes, users should see smoother animations in the 3D Action-RPG Template. We were able to fix the rendering overlaps and smooth out the animation stuttering. Additionally, we fixed the missing airplane animation as well. 

Log Messages Won't Disappear Over Time

Users have submitted reports that the log messages were not disappearing over time after executing custom events within the map/interface editors. We fixed that issued and hope that you take advantage in using custom events within the map/interface editors. As a quick reminder, we recently released a new feature from the previous update that enables users to click "list" option in custom events and network messages. Game developers who are making a life simulator game in a farm environment might find it beneficial to have a custom event that lists the animals, animal actions and more. 

Too Many Terraformations

We've gotten reports from folks who experienced an issue when creating too many terraformations. We've fixed the problem and wanted to mention that more users should often use the terraformation system. The tile terraformation window allows the user to utilize concave and convex tiles (as well as neighboring tiles as an option), which means that that the user can ultimately change how a pool of water should  be visually seen when it on the ground or grass tiles. Variability options (like color and rotation) are also available to the user when making a change in the terraformation.

If so, game developers will be excited   to know that we corrected the vehicles for not properly responding to the map boundary connections. For engine users who are not interested involving any vehicles, we also fixed some crashes that focuses on the player or party. Added "Zoom Scale Ratio" and "Disable Lighting" to "Add Parallax" event.


As always, you can view the full change log on our website here.

End of Year Review
It's been an eventful year for us in 2019 and given that this is our last major update of the year, we wanted to take the time to reflect on all of things that came out this year.

At the beginning of the year we made a huge change to 001, with the implementation of full UNICODE support - one of our most requested features! Since then, we've continued to make improvements and will further improve this in 2020 so that all aspects of 001 fully support UNICODE characters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/b1b298e2f87759bbee6849b6e4f3af9efa51a349.png

We added a screenshot capture mode that allows you to take screenshots of your game using Alt+P that can then be exported as PNG files or submitted directly to our web server, where it can be promoted freely across our social media platforms - A great way to get more eyes on your 001 games!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/3bb2c1a2e05c8ab2bdb962090f4fe4852de31d28.png

We released a brand new DLC Kit - Our Visual Novel Kit, a highly requested template that allows visual novels and 'choose your own adventure' style games to be made with ease. And it's currently on sale for 40% off in the Steam Winter Sale!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/09412d360f8b12eb161fdfc64ba70a6692b9fa99.png

...But that's not all because we also released our first resource pack - Dragon's Den which added a bunch of new Sprites, Tile-Sets and Music/Sounds for use in your 001 projects. Incidentally, this resource pack is also 40% off in the Steam Winter Sale!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/4a459554436060aef020f53f6bf0d8a97e7d77ff.png

We gave Android builds a complete overhaul, making them far more robust and adding support for both 32-bit and 64-bit modules, whilst increasing the API Level to 28. This change has brought us one step closer towards implementing Ads and IAPs that have been highly requested by the community, and we're pleased to announce that these additions will finally be arriving in 2020!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/73ad0121c0027eaf676be8328146ab399ed81156.png

We also started some early work on a Dark UI for 001 Game Creator - another feature that is highly requested. While there is still much more work that needs to be done, we hope to have this feature implemented next year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/9df42c5d61ae380da11c1732a4e3c70a0d417c06.png
A VERY early test at getting a Dark UI working in 001. Not representative of the final look.

On top of all of these additions, we've also spent the last year fixing numerous bugs, implementing various quality of life improvements, and adding many smaller features that have been requested by our community. We hope to continue this trend moving forward in order to make 2020 an even better year for 001 Game Creator! We have a lot of cool stuff in the pipeline, so we hope you look forward to seeing what we've got in store for the future!

Until then, on behalf of everyone on the team, we'd like to wish you all a Merry Christmas, and a Happy New Year! Thank you all for your continued support over the past year. We hope to see even more amazing games from you in the new year!

notes.title: New Version - UNICODE Improvements and Startup Crash Fixes
notes.notes:
We've updated 001 Game Creator to v2019.001.003 which includes some very important fixes to our initial UNICODE implementation and mobile builds!

UNICODE Implementation Fixes

In our last announcement, we revealed our first implementation of UNICODE support in 001 Game Creator (a long-time requested feature from our community). Since then, we've worked with our users on refining this implementation - most notably in fixing an issue with certain international configurations of Windows that would cause characters to display incorrectly.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/b1b298e2f87759bbee6849b6e4f3af9efa51a349.png

Additionally, we've made it easier to add/remove certain blocks of characters to your fonts with the appropriately named "Add Block" and "Remove Block" buttons. There's even a "Custom" option, where you can specify a UNICODE hex range to add specific groups of characters!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/6a26ece88cfed135439781665caa29b1b9f22dd6.png

We will continue to improve our UNICODE implementation over the coming weeks/months so that all necessary parts of the engine can display these characters correctly. We'd also like to thank those of you that have been helping us to improve our UNICODE implementation!

Numerous Editor Start Up Crash Fixes

While working to re-create the UNICODE problems some users were experiencing, we noticed several areas where 001 Game Creator would crash upon start up if the user's video card didn't properly support windowed swap chains, advanced material shaders, texture colour mapping, or large textures used by system fonts.

If you've previously experienced crashes when starting 001 Game Creator then these fixes should make a huge difference!

Android/iOS Build Fixes

Another important fix in this update is the Android/iOS build functionality that wasn't working as intended. You should now be able to build your game for Android and iOS without issue - we've also fixed an issue where built APK files would crash upon start up!

Additionally, for those of you with larger games, we've fixed an issue that resulted in an error during the build process.

As always, you can see a full list of changes here: http://001gamecreator.com/changes/

Full UNICODE Support (Beta)

Perhaps one of the most requested features, and also one of the most challenging features to implement, is the ability to fully support UNICODE characters to allow for foreign languages like Russian and Chinese (which previously weren't supported).

With 001 being built on VB6 (which doesn't natively support UNICODE characters) this was always seen as an impossible feature request...That is until now! We'll spare you the boring technical details and just say that a new discovery was recently found that would allow 001 to support these characters with only a little work on our end - and so we're pleased to announce that UNICODE support is finally available in 001 Game Creator! 

However, since this is still only our first implementation, we'd like to hear input/feedback from our community! There are also still some things not implemented to support UNICODE fully in some parts of the engine.

(Some screenshots showcasing Russian characters):

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/24a062eaf58ad4d112f665d69031a23dfb5fe034.png

Please Note: You'll need to explicitly add UNICODE characters to your font files first - otherwise they won't be recognised in-game!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/acb549dfb3d4214097769431b06e8e36813187d1.png

Improvements To Fonts

Our UNICODE implementation has also had an added benefit to fonts in general as we've now managed to pack characters in better which means that the padding option is no longer necessary in most cases. As such, the look of characters will appear more natural than before (where spacing wasn't being properly obeyed)

We've also enlarged font images from 2048x1024 to 2048x2048 so that fonts can store more characters!

A Few Smaller User-Requested Features

While UNICODE support is one of the largest feature requests implemented in this version - we've also taken the time to implement a few smaller requests that didn't require much time to add. These include:

Change Reverse, Rising and Falling Speed Events - Three new events that change the Reverse Speed, Rising Speed and Falling Speed of Actors has been added.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/a61e831b1e2a97bcbe9c585a4d41265c0986fdfe.png

Change Currency Symbol Visual Setting - You can now effortlessly change the currency symbol used for Money by going to Game Settings > Visual Settings. This is also useful, given the implementation of UNICODE and the various different types of currencies used around the globe.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/f8ed3d8fb4b59417514ebfbc0dee1f9f60099088.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/da8df5c2982b08ff7e47f851a35e44145e3435b6.png

Until Next Time...

notes.title: NEW Features and a NEW Release!
notes.notes:
With our 3D FPS / Survival Horror Kit finally released, we're now back into the full swing of things! A new version of 001 Game Creator (v1.018.008) is now available on Steam and is packed with tons of new content and bug fixes.

As always, you can see the full change log HERE Now let's go over some of these changes, shall we?

Updated New / Open Game Window

What better place to start than with the first thing you're greeted with upon opening 001 Game Creator. In an effort to make 001 a little more user-friendly, we've tweaked the New / Open Game window to be more streamlined:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/dccebce9c9d1820e5e7be86d32434a86f3ba3093.png

Updated Main Toolbar

Additionally, we've cleaned up the main toolbar by removing the icons for Legacy Settings (now called Advanced Game Settings), Visual Settings and Startup Menu Settings. These options are still available in the main menu, as always, and are also now accessible in the Game Settings window too:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/9a37a1151ccba94ecbe86032c196e379d31517ab.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/ae530962d98a8854cf28d993a51e6122b7893c2e.png

Sprite Materials And Normal Maps

Normal Mapping and Material Editing are now available for Sprites, having previously only been available for Tile-Sets, giving you access to custom shaders across the board!  They work the same way too! Simply select "Normal" from the "Mapping" drop down menu to add/edit your Sprite's normal maps. To edit materials, just click the "Edit Material" button next to the "Graphic Scripting" button to open the Material Editor:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/23777ffeff2ff3f55ad6d8ef05c85345853e13df.png

Walking Animation Scale

This new Actor Graphic Option allows you to create fixed animation speeds, which is something that several users have been asking for. Essentially, this option allows you to specify the frame rate at which the Sprite animation plays at, regardless of its speed.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/5f14286876a76dc5b7f1ebccde913bfd34fbc57f.png

Performance Debugger

We've updated 001's Debugger with a new "Performance" section that lists slow triggers and collisions. We hope this extra feedback will prove useful to those looking to optimise their games for the best possible performance!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/cb4d5ceddc8e6725c2c0efd894d260368032db2a.png

Improved Pathfinding

Pathfinding (used by AI and for "Walk to..." type events) has been greatly improved, resulting in a lot of fixes to issues that have plagued users for some time, including characters teleporting into or getting stuck in nearby collisions.

Ignore Cursor Field Option

And lastly, a small but very useful Field option that allows you to create overlaying Fields without them obstructing selectable Fields underneath them!

001 Games Showcase!

As we mentioned last time, we've created an official 001 Game Creator Instagram account where we've been sharing all of your 001 game creations! If you're on Instagram then please feel free to follow us for new posts every Monday, Thursday and Saturday! If you're got a 001 game you'd like us to showcase, then don't hesitate to get in contact with us!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/72b8630e9bf993c1ea601efdca037399d48e9c41.png

Oh, and one last thing!

We hope you enjoy the latest version and all that it has to offer. We're still working hard on our planned Point & Click Adventure Kit and so, with that said, here's a small parting gift from the team...a little sneak peek:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/3dd81c6985dfa155552507f8f853a74789ed711a.png
